subject: PS
stem: 32-year-old low mood, anhedonia, weight loss, insomnia, guilt 3 weeks + somatic aches. First-line?
options: B. SSRI (e.g. sertraline) + CBT + suicide-risk assessment + follow-up
explanation: Moderate-severe depression: SSRI + psychotherapy, safety plan, monitor activation/suicide early. Treat somatic pain within depression.

subject: PS
stem: 18-year-old binge-eats then vomits, feels overweight, BMI 16.5. Diagnosis?
explanation: Recall: BMI <18.5 + body-image distortion = anorexia even with binge/purge. Bulimia usually normal/overweight. Needs MDT refeeding + psych.

subject: PS
stem: Panic attacks, palpitations, catastrophic thoughts, avoids malls. Best long-term?
options: B. SSRI + CBT (exposure) + breathing/relaxation; avoid daily benzos
explanation: Panic/GAD: CBT + SSRI first-line. Benzos only short crisis due to dependence.

subject: PS
stem: Intrusive contamination fears + 2-hour washing rituals, knows excessive. Diagnosis and best therapy?
options: B. OCD – SSRI (high dose) + exposure-response prevention
explanation: OCD: obsessions + compulsions + insight. ERP + SSRI/clomipramine; augment if resistant.

subject: PS
stem: Nightmares, flashbacks after crash, hyperarousal, avoidance 2 months. Best next step?
options: B. Trauma-focused CBT/EMDR + SSRI if needed; screen suicide/substance
explanation: PTSD >1 month: trauma-focused therapy first; meds adjunct. Early support, not single debrief.

subject: PS
stem: 22-year-old deliberate self-harm, says will repeat. Best immediate action?
options: B. Risk assessment + safety planning + collateral + psychiatry referral/admit if high risk; remove means
explanation: Self-harm: empathic risk stratification, protective factors, means restriction, follow-up <48h, involve family with consent unless imminent risk.

subject: PS
stem: 8-year-old inattentive, hyperactive, impairing school/home >6 mo. First-line after behavioural?
options: B. Methylphenidate/atomoxetine + parent training + school plan; monitor growth/BP
explanation: ADHD: confirm pervasiveness, exclude vision/hearing/thyroid/sleep; stimulants effective with monitoring.

subject: PS
stem: Chronic insomnia, daytime benzodiazepine request. Best?
options: B. CBT-I + sleep hygiene + taper benzos; short hypnotic only if needed
explanation: Insomnia: CBT-I beats pills. Taper benzos (dependence/rebound), treat apnea/depression/RLS.

subject: PS
stem: Patient on lithium: what to monitor regularly?
options: B. Renal function + thyroid + lithium levels + hydration + interactions (NSAID/diuretic)
explanation: Recall: lithium renally cleared, narrow index → nephrogenic DI, hypothyroidism, toxicity with dehydration/NSAIDs. Check levels 12h post-dose.

subject: PS
stem: Triad incontinence + dementia + gait apraxia, ventriculomegaly + periventricular hyperintensity. Diagnosis?
options: B. Normal-pressure hydrocephalus – refer neurosurgery (tap test/shunt if responsive)
explanation: NPH: wet-wobbly-wacky. Tap test predicts shunt response. Rule out obstructive/vascular.

subject: PS
stem: 2 years isolated, poor hygiene, flat affect, no friends, no positive psychosis. Most likely personality pattern?
options: A. Schizoid personality pattern (lifelong detachment, restricted affect)
explanation: Recall: persistent social detachment + restricted affect without psychosis = schizoid pattern; monitor for schizophrenia prodrome, support ADLs.

subject: PS
stem: Elevated mood, reduced sleep, grandiosity, overspending 1 week, impaired function. Best acute?
options: B. Mood stabiliser/antipsychotic (e.g. valproate/olanzapine) + safety + stop antidepressant; bipolar mania workup
explanation: Mania: stop pro-manic agents, stabilise, protect finances/safety, psychoeducation + lithium/valproate maintenance.
